activity.notes: William Marshal personally commanded the royalist relief force for Henry III against French and rebel forces at the Second Battle of Lincoln on 20 May 1217. This is a military command Activity distinct from his ongoing constitutional regency. The battle should not be reinterpreted as Marshal ruling a new state. Julian calendar corresponds to the historical English contemporary dating convention.

sources.title: Historic England — The Second Battle of Lincoln (1217), Historic Environment Record
sources.citation_text: Historic England heritage record dates the Second Battle of Lincoln to 20 May 1217 and explicitly identifies William Marshal as commander of the king's relief force.
